the rate of inadequate antibiotic therapy was high in a university hospital with no antibiotic use restrictions, and that the main target of any intervention aiming at reducing antibiotic use should be the initial empirical antibiotic therapy.

in a university hospital where no restrictive antibiotic policies are enforced, the rate of inadequate antibiotic therapy was similar to the rate reported from other institutions, and that adjusted antibiotic therapies were even more frequently inappropriate than the empirical therapies.
